svg.title: Invite many people at once — SoftTrack web design mockup (#304)
svg.desc: The invitation form takes one address and sends one invitation to one team. An admin pastes addresses, chooses a role and the teams they administer, sees a preview of who will be invited, who is already a member and which lines are not addresses, and gets a summary afterwards.
svg.text: · thirty trips through a form, made one
Fifteen people, two teams, one trip through the form

g.text: Settings → Members → Invite people, signed in as Lena
Paste addresses, separated by commas, spaces or new lines.
fresh link for Support; to Product
6 entries · 9 invitations · 1 is not an address
failed: the mail server refused it
when there is no mail server

svg.text: One invitation per address per team
A link stays tied to the address it was made for
A fresh link retires the one before it
A limit on addresses per submission
Where admins may create accounts, #303, the same list can create
It returns a result per address.
Done when an admin can paste addresses separated by commas, spaces or new lines, choose a role and one or more teams they administer, see a preview before anything is
sent, send one invitation per address per team by email or as links to copy, and read a summary of what was sent, skipped and failed with reasons; with a limit per submission and
a result per address from the API.
